terrain.seaEncoding: The Søgne 2013 GeoTIFF has no nodata tag. Exact 0.0 cells connected to the edge of this window are stored as NaN and drawn as sea. Other values, including negatives along the shore, are kept. Grid spacing is not a surveyed accuracy.
